The '''2024–25 Alabama Crimson Tide men's basketball team''' represented the [[University of Alabama]] during the [[2024–25 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The Crimson Tide were led by sixth-year head coach [[Nate Oats]] and played their home games at [[Coleman Coliseum]] located in [[Tuscaloosa, Alabama]] as a member of the [[Southeastern Conference|SEC]].

==Previous season==
The [[2023–24 Alabama Crimson Tide men's basketball team|Crimson Tide]] finished the [[2023–24 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2023–24 season]] with a record of 25–12, 13–5 in SEC play to finish in a tie for second place. They were defeated by [[2023–24 Florida Gators men's basketball team|Florida Gators]] in the quarterfinals of the [[2024 SEC men's basketball tournament|SEC tournament]] championship. They received an at-large bid to the [[2024 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] as the number four seed in the West Region, where they beat [[2023–24 Charleston Cougars men's basketball team|Charleston]] in the first round, [[2023–24 Grand Canyon Antelopes men's basketball team|Grand Canyon]] in the second round to advance to the Sweet Sixteen, where they upset the one seed [[2023–24 North Carolina Tar Heels men's basketball team|North Carolina]], where they would then advance to the Final Four for the first time in school history beating [[2023–24 Clemson Tigers men's basketball team|Clemson]] but were defeated by the eventual national champions, the [[2023–24 UConn Huskies men's basketball team|UConn Huskies]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Alabama basketball cashes ticket to Final Four with win over Clemson |url=https://www.tuscaloosanews.com/story/sports/college/basketball/2024/03/30/alabama-basketball-clemson-score-elite-eight-ncaa-tournament-mark-sears-final-four/73067020007/ |access-date=29 July 2024 |website=The Tuscaloosa News |language=en-US}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=2023-24 Alabama Crimson Tide Men's Schedule and Results |url=https://www.sports-reference.com/cbb/schools/alabama/men/2024-schedule.html |website=Sports Reference |access-date=29 July 2024}}</ref>
